results.title: Copy My Data: Transfer Content

What you can transfer
• Contacts and phone numbers
• Photos and videos
• Music and audio files
• Calendar events

How it works

Install Copy My Data on both phones.
Connect both devices to the same WiFi network.
Open the app and choose to send data on your old phone.
Choose to receive data on your new phone.
Scan the QR code to connect the phones.
Select what you want to copy and start the data transfer.
The app will copy data from your old phone to your new smart phone and keep it in the same quality. Your files stay on your old device until the copy is complete, so you can safely check that everything has been moved.

• No cables, PC or cloud account required

Whether you are upgrading, switching brands or setting up a second device, Copy My Data helps you transfer data without stress. Start a data transfer today and copy your important content to your new smart phone in minutes using secure WiFi transfer data to move and switch content safely.

results.title: Autosync for Google Drive
results.snippet:
This app is an automatic file sync and backup tool. It lets you automatically synchronize files and folders with Google Drive cloud storage and with your other devices. It is an ideal tool for photo sync, document and file backup, automatic file transfer, automatic file sharing between devices,...

New files in your cloud account are automatically downloaded onto your device. New files in your device are uploaded. If you delete a file on one side, it will be deleted on the other side. It works across multiple devices (your phone and your tablet). If their folders are synced with the same cloud account, they will be kept in sync with each other.

This is how Google Drive works on computers but not on Android. Two-way automatic synchronization should be an essential function of the official app. For whatever reason, it is not the case. Autosync for Google Drive is here to fill the gap.

All file transfers and communications between user devices and cloud storage servers are securely encrypted and do not go through our servers. No outsiders will be able to decrypt, see or modify any file contents.

MAIN FEATURES

• Full two-way automatic synchronization of files and folders
• Very efficient, consumes almost no battery
• Easy to set up. Once set up files will be kept in sync without any effort from users
• Works reliably under ever changing network conditions on your phone
• Monitors battery level, WiFi/3G/4G/LTE connectivity and adapts its behavior according to user preferences
• Configurable autosync interval: 15 minutes, 30 minutes, every hour,...

If you like this app, please consider upgrading to premium version. By doing so you support the development efforts and get access to premium features. You can upgrade via in-app purchase.

PREMIUM FEATURES

• Sync multiple pairs of folders
• Upload files larger than 10 MB
• Sync your entire cloud account with a folder in your device
• Sync with multiple accounts
• Sync with shared drives
• Protect app settings with passcode
• No ads displayed in the app
• Email support by developer

SUPPORT

results.title: Data Eraser - iShredder
results.snippet:
iShredder™ – secure data eraser & file shredder for Android
Protect your personal and work data before you sell, trade in, repair, recycle or hand over your phone. iShredder securely overwrites photos, files, folders and empty space, making later recovery extremely difficult even with recovery apps or forensic tools.

WHY NORMAL DELETE ISN’T ENOUGH
Deleting a file on Android often removes its reference without immediately overwriting the storage area it occupied. Depending on the device, Android version and storage technology, residual data may remain. iShredder targets selected content and empty space for secure overwriting instead of merely removing files from view.

CERTIFIED, MILITARY-GRADE ERASURE
iShredder supports recognized methods such as DoD 5220.22-M, NIST SP 800-88, BSI TL-03423 and other international standards. Choose a quick one-pass wipe for routine tasks or a stricter multi-pass process for particularly sensitive information.

The Android app has been independently assessed and awarded DEKRA MASA L1 security certification under OWASP MASVS Level 1 requirements. iShredder also received the Fortress Cybersecurity Award 2025 for its data-erasure technology and app security.

WHAT YOU CAN WIPE
• Photos, videos and personal media
• Documents, downloads, files and complete folders
• App traces, hidden caches, logs, temporary files and thumbnails
• Empty space in internal storage and supported SD cards
• Work data on corporate, BYOD and shared devices

KEY FEATURES
• Selective secure erase
Choose exactly which files, folders or storage areas should be overwritten.

• Multiple certified algorithms
Choose the right balance of speed and protection.

• Built-in file explorer
Locate private content and select it directly for secure shredding.

• Erasure reports
Create a record for device handover, audits and privacy workflows. Reports depend on the edition.

• BYOD & user changes
Remove work data before return, repair, reassignment, resale or employee offboarding.

COMMON USE CASES
• Wipe an Android phone before sale, trade-in, buy-back or recycling
• Remove private photos, documents and downloads before repair
• Reduce remnants after uninstalling apps by wiping empty space
• Clean corporate and BYOD devices during device or staff changes
• Document repeatable disposal and handover procedures with reports

HOW THE WIPE WORKS
1. Select files, folders, app traces, empty space or a storage area.
2. Choose the erasure algorithm suited to your security needs.
3. Start the wipe — iShredder overwrites the selected areas and, where available, generates an erasure report.

FOR BUSINESS, IT & PRIVACY OPERATIONS
Certified methods and reports help organizations manage device rotation, returns, reuse, onboarding/offboarding and internal security procedures. They can support documented data-disposal and GDPR-aligned privacy workflows when combined with your organization’s compliance requirements.

ADVANCED OPTIONS WHEN YOU NEED MORE
Depending on the edition, iShredder provides additional deletion algorithms, extended reports and professional options for power users, businesses and public-sector teams. Use iShredder for regular privacy maintenance, shared devices and repeatable IT processes.

PRIVACY & SECURITY BY DESIGN
Connections to Protectstar services use modern TLS encryption. The app avoids unnecessary data collection and, as stated in Google Play’s Data Safety section, does not share user data with third parties.

Note: Features, algorithms and reports can vary by device, Android version and iShredder edition.

With iShredder, “deleted” really means securely erased.
